race.description: Share Bets With Tabtouch Bet Loop Hcp (C3)
race.comment: THE ROCKET (7) missed by 1.6L at Northam first-up before a 2.4L victory at this track last time out as the odds-on favourite. Riordan's claim is a big tick and his early speed is a bonus. Can roll forward from the draw and play a leading role once again. CLASSIC RULER (11) won in a photo two back before missing by 1.9L at this track and trip a fortnight ago. Pike hops on board today, replacing the apprentice hoop and he's won when riding previously. Can burn across from the gate and put himself in the firing line. YOU CAN CALL ME AL (8) scored on resumption before a 4.3L defeat at this track and trip last time out. Fiore takes the ride now anbd he's placed in both third-up attempts. Watch for him flying later. BOUSSAC (2) disappointed fresh but can improve sharply.
